title: Breach Protocol
description: Browser FPS with real gun feel: three weapons with distinct recoil (M4, M9, M870 pump), front-sight ADS, TEMPO DRIVE bullet-time on Q, HDR bloom pipeline, destructible-feeling dusk city with strafing AI. Attract mode plays itself until you click. Generated and iteratively tuned by GLM-5.3 Flash via omp over 7 rounds.
